issue_context.title: Reload blocks every minute irrespective of compaction taking place
issue_context.body: **What did you do?** I am trying the new command `tsdb create-blocks-from openmetrics` of `promtool`, input file content is : ```yaml # HELP http_requests_total The total number of HTTP requests. # TYPE http_requests_total counter http_requests_total{code="200"} 1021 1607491300.989 http_requests_total{code="200"} 1022 1607491330 http_requests_total{code="200"} 1026 1607491360 http_requests_total{code="200"} 1029 1607491390.989 http_requests_total{code="200"} 1030 1607491420.989 http_requests_total{code="200"} 1032 1607491450 http_requests_total{code="200"} 1033 1607491480 http_requests_total{code="200"} 1038 1607491510.989 http_requests_total{code="400"} 2 1607491300.989 http_requests_total{code="400"} 2 1607491330 http_requests_total{code="400"} 3 1607491390.989 http_requests_total{code="400"} 3 1607491420.989 http_requests_total{code="400"} 3 1607491450 http_requests_total{code="400"} 4 1607491360.989 http_requests_total{code="400"} 4 1607491480.989 http_requests_total{code="400"} 5 1607491510 # EOF ``` running command with result: ```bash ./promtool tsdb create-blocks-from openmetrics backfill-demo.txt BLOCK ULID MIN TIME MAX TIME DURATION NUM SAMPLES NUM CHUNKS NUM SERIES SIZE 01ES3Y6KHEAZR7NX00SNP35V26 2020-12-09 05:21:40 +0000 UTC 2020-12-09 05:25:10 +0000 UTC 3m30.001s 15 2 2 769B ``` then I query the input data but without result: It works after restart prometheus server: Not sure it's a bug or a feature, maybe it should hot reload new blocks rather than restart the server. **Environment** * System information: Darwin 17.7.0 x86_64 * Prometheus version: ``` prometheus, version 2.23.0 (branch: master, revision: e13f4a5f6e93c51b0238e2b7095e575e905ad758) build user: songjiayang@ZBMAC-90549ae81 build date: 20201209-14:31:13 go version: go1.14.6 platform: darwin/amd64 ```

It looks like we only automatically reload after a compaction, so it could take up to the next head compaction for it to happen automatically.
Thx, I have do a new test  and confirm that it will take up after head compaction.

Assuming that the admin API is enabled, could promtool call the `/-/reload` endpoint somehow? 

edit: nevermind, it reloads the config and not the TSDB
Not with this subcommand, it has nothing to do with a Prometheus server.
Modified the issue title. Also, reloading the blocks every minute will also increase the resolution at which we check retention policies.
If no one is working on this one, I'd like to try it out :)

review_comments: We should be protecting it with `db.cmtx` lock here.

I've added a commit with the lock :)

But what exactly does this particular lock do? It does not allow compactions to happen while the mutex is locked?

> It does not allow compactions to happen while the mutex is locked?

Yes. `reloadBlocks` indirectly depends on the compaction mutex to avoid races since we did reload only during compaction until now.
